title: Suspension of a map G: Lipschitz bounds, derivative, range and Gram determinant (parent step 4)
statement: For N, n ∈ ℕ write Φ_d(t, u) := (t, u_1, …, u_d) ∈ ℝ^{d+1} for t ∈ ℝ, u ∈ ℝ^d (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))), e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{N+1} and Jv := Φ_N(0, v) for v ∈ ℝ^N. Let G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N and Gh : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^{N+1} satisfy Gh(Φ_n(t, u)) = Φ_N(t, G(u)) for all t ∈ ℝ, u ∈ ℝⁿ. Then: (i) if G is L-Lipschitz (L ≥ 0), then Gh is max(1, L)-Lipschitz; (ii) for every m ∈ ℝ and A ⊆ ℝⁿ with m|a − a'| ≤ |G(a) − G(a')| for all a, a' ∈ A: min(1, m)|Φ_n(t, u) − Φ_n(t', u')| ≤ |Gh(Φ_n(t, u)) − Gh(Φ_n(t', u'))| for all t, t' ∈ ℝ and u, u' ∈ A; (iii) if G is differentiable at u ∈ ℝⁿ, then for every t ∈ ℝ, with z := Φ_n(t, u): Gh is differentiable at z; DGh(z)(Φ_n(s, w)) = Φ_N(s, DG(u)w) for all s ∈ ℝ, w ∈ ℝⁿ; DGh(z) is injective if DG(u) is injective; range DGh(z) = span(insert e₀ (J(range DG(u)))); and det(⟨DGh(z)b_i, DGh(z)b_j⟩)_{i,j<n+1} = det(⟨DG(u)c_i, DG(u)c_j⟩)_{i,j<n}, where b_i ∈ ℝ^{n+1}, c_i ∈ ℝⁿ are the standard basis vectors (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) and D = fderiv.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid N) (Gh : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (N + 1)), (∀ (t : ℝ) (u : Euclid n), Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp (G u)))) → (∀ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L G → LipschitzWith (max 1 L) Gh) ∧ (∀ (m : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid n)), (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → ∀ (t t' : ℝ), ∀ u ∈ A, ∀ u' ∈ A, min 1 m * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u)) : Euclid (n + 1)) - WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t' (WithLp.ofLp u'))‖ ≤ ‖Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) - Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t' (WithLp.ofLp u')))‖) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (u : Euclid n), DifferentiableAt ℝ G u → DifferentiableAt ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) ∧ (∀ (s : ℝ) (w : Euclid n), fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp w))) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp (fderiv ℝ G u w)))) ∧ (Injective (fderiv ℝ G u) → Injective (fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))))) ∧ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (N + 1)) = Submodule.span ℝ (insert (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) ((fun v : Euclid N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)) : Euclid (N + 1))) '' (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ G u : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid N) : Set (Euclid N)))) ∧ Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (n + 1) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))
